verdict.rationale: DPMA's online services (DPMAregister, DEPATISnet, DPMAdirektWeb/Pro) hold user filings and records, so data portability is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a bulk export of a user's data in open formats or any account-exit path. The docs cover only searching, filing routes and application software.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
